# Setup

```{r}
source("setup.R")
```

Read in park system

```{r}
# park_system <- getParkSystem()
# read in pre-saved park file
parks <- st_read("data/rapid/all/park_boundaries_2025-08-14.gpkg")
```

Read in water supply database for filtered parks

```{r}
table_path <- "data/Water_Supply_Systems/NPS_Water_Systems_Database_Joined.xlsx"


water_supplies <- read_excel(table_path,
                             sheet = 1,
                             na = c("NA", "U"),
                             skip = 1) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    source_longitude = as.numeric(source_longitude),
    source_latitude = as.numeric(source_latitude)
  ) %>%
  filter(!state %in% c("AK", "AS", "HI", "MP", "PR", "VI")) %>%
  filter(!source_type %in% c("Municipal", "Hauled")) %>%
  drop_na(source_longitude, source_latitude) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = (c("source_longitude", "source_latitude")),
           crs = 4326,
           remove = FALSE)


```

Save water supplies to app data

```{r}
write_csv(water_supplies, "rapid_app/app_data/water_supplies.csv")
```

*For each water supply point, calculate indicator at point + \~5km buffer.*

# Create water supply buffer for raster stats
To create appropriate buffers (i.e., smooth instead of jagged), need to apply st_buffer to sf object in a UTM CRS (instead of lat/long)
```{r}
water_supplies_buffer <- water_supplies %>% 
  st_transform(crs = 32616) %>% 
  st_buffer(dist = 5000)
```


# Calculate Indicators

Each indicator (or component of multiple indicators) should have its own calculation function in a standalone .R file. Below is a standardized template for indicator functions:

```{r eval = FALSE}
calc_[indicator]_[type] <- function( 
  water_supplies,           # sf object with water supply locations
  [indicator_data],         # specific data for this indicator
  additional_data = NULL,   # optional additional datasets
  save = FALSE,            # whether to save output
  output_dir = NULL,       # directory for saving
  verbose = TRUE           # progress messages
) {
  # Function body
} 
```

# Exposure

## Fire

Increase in likelihood of fires

Prep pyrome data

```{r}
# read in input datasets
pyromes <- st_read("data/all/usfs_fire/Pyromes-RDS-2020-0020/Data/Pyromes_CONUS_20200206.shp") %>%
  st_make_valid() %>% 
  sf::st_transform(st_crs(water_supplies))


# GAO 2021 FIRE PROBABILITY
crosswalk <- read_csv("data/all/usfs_fire/fire_projections_gao_2021/gcm_crosswalk.csv")

# Back-casted GCMs, compared against GridMet. Really just need GridMet.
fireprob_historic <- read_csv("data/all/usfs_fire/fire_projections_gao_2021/tables3-fireprob-hist.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(PYROME, GridMet)

# Midcentury is defined as the avg. across 2040-2070:
delta_fireprob <- read_csv("data/all/usfs_fire/fire_projections_gao_2021//tables12-45-midcentury.csv") %>%
  pivot_longer(-PYROME, names_to = "gao") %>%
  left_join(crosswalk, by = "gao") %>%
  mutate(GCM = paste0(GCM, ".rcp45")) %>%
  # do same thing on the 85 CFs, then bind together:
  bind_rows(
    read_csv("data/all/usfs_fire/fire_projections_gao_2021//tables6-85-midcentury.csv") %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(-PYROME, names_to = "gao", values_to = "value") %>%
      left_join(crosswalk, by = "gao") %>%
      mutate(GCM = paste0(GCM, ".rcp85"))
  ) %>%
  # join historic data by pyrome:
  left_join(fireprob_historic, by = "PYROME") %>%
  # Description: "The probability of a fire increases/decreases by `delta_fp` percent." 
  mutate(delta_fp = 100 * ((value - GridMet)/GridMet)) 

# Pull 10th, 50th and 90th percentile values for each pyrome
pyromes_selected <- delta_fireprob %>%
 group_by(PYROME) %>%
 slice(c(which.min(abs(delta_fp - quantile(delta_fp, 0.1))),
         which.min(abs(delta_fp - quantile(delta_fp, 0.5))),
         which.min(abs(delta_fp - quantile(delta_fp, 0.9))))) %>%
 mutate(percentile = case_when(
   delta_fp == delta_fp[which.min(abs(delta_fp - quantile(delta_fp, 0.1)))] ~ "p10",
   delta_fp == delta_fp[which.min(abs(delta_fp - quantile(delta_fp, 0.5)))] ~ "p50", 
   delta_fp == delta_fp[which.min(abs(delta_fp - quantile(delta_fp, 0.9)))] ~ "p90"
 )) %>%
 ungroup() %>%
 pivot_wider(
   names_from = percentile,
   values_from = c(gao, value, GCM, GridMet, delta_fp),
   names_sep = "_"
 )


```


```{r}
# Calculate indicator
fire_exp <- calc_fire_exposure(
  water_supplies = st_filter(water_supplies, pyromes),
  fire_prob_data = pyromes_selected,
  pyrome_data = pyromes,
  save = TRUE,
  output_dir = "data/rapid/all"
)

# BENCHMARK 
## 38.45 secs for 23 parks
## 50.46 MINs for 641 parks
## 1.2 hours for 1184 parks
```

## Runoff

```{r}
runoff_exp <- calc_runoff_exposure(water_supplies = water_supplies,

# 23 minutes
```

# Sensitivity

## Fire

Wildfire hazard potential

```{r}
# Calculate indicator
fire_sen <- calc_fire_sensitivity(water_supplies = water_supplies_buffer,
                          whp_raster = "data/all/usfs_fire/whp2023_GeoTIF/whp2023_cls_conus.tif",
                          whp_type = "cat",
                          save = TRUE,
                          output_dir = "data/rapid/all"
                          )

# BENCHMARKING
## 1.91 mins for 23 parks
## 54.1 mins for 677 parks
# New categorical method:
# 2.77 mins for 1140 parks
```


Test function including moderate categories with high and very high:
```{r}
whp_raster <- terra::rast("data/all/usfs_fire/whp2023_GeoTIF/whp2023_cls_conus.tif")


binary <- terra::ifel(whp_raster %in% 3:5, 1, 0)

# Process each water supply
results <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(water_supplies_buffer)), function(i) {
 
    # Calculate area-weighted % high/very high WHP category for water supply buffer
    
    ## pull out park shapefile and transform
    ws <- terra::vect(st_transform(water_supplies_buffer[i, ], crs(whp_raster)))
    
    # Extract values with cell overlap fractions
    extracted <- terra::extract(binary, ws, weights = TRUE, exact = TRUE)
    
    # weights column = fraction of cell in polygon
    total_weight <- sum(extracted$weight, na.rm = TRUE)
    coverage_weight <- sum(extracted$weight[extracted$class_desc == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
    
    percent <- (coverage_weight / total_weight) * 100
    
    # Create results tibble
    tibble(
      wsd_source_id = water_supplies_buffer[i, ]$wsd_source_id,
      park_unit = water_supplies_buffer[i, ]$park_unit,
      park_name = water_supplies_buffer[i, ]$park_name,
      raw_wildfire_hazard_mean = percent
    )
    
    
  }
  
  
  
)

# Calculate standardized indicators using helper function
final_results <- results %>%
  add_standardized_indicators("raw_wildfire_hazard")

filename <- file.path("data/rapid/all/", paste0("fire_sensitivity_moderate", Sys.Date(), ".csv"))
write_csv(final_results, filename)
    
```


## Testing

Filter to Utah parks for testing

```{r}
# park boundaries and metadata
parks_sub <- parks %>% filter(STATE == "UT")


# park water supplies
table_path <- "data/Water_Supply_Systems/NPS_Water_Systems_Database_Joined.xlsx"


water_supplies_sub <- read_excel(table_path,
                             sheet = 1,
                             na = c("NA", "U"),
                             skip = 1) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    source_longitude = as.numeric(source_longitude),
    source_latitude = as.numeric(source_latitude)
  ) %>%
  filter(park_unit %in% parks_sub$UNIT_CODE) %>%
  filter(!source_type %in% c("Municipal", "Hauled")) %>%
  drop_na(source_longitude, source_latitude) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = (c("source_longitude", "source_latitude")),
           crs = 4326,
           remove = FALSE)
```
